# Alpy

> Alpy is a free, privacy-first ski app for iPhone (2026/27 season):
> GPS day tracking with per-run personal records and a race chart,
> powder alerts, official avalanche bulletins, OpenStreetMap trail
> maps for 3,652 ski areas (51 hand-verified), day replay on 3D
> terrain, and fully on-device AI reports (Apple Intelligence — no
> cloud AI, no keys). No account, no ads, no server —
> GPS never leaves the phone. Every feature is free; there is no
> premium tier.

- [What Alpy is](https://rohan3008.github.io/alpine-support/)
- [Alpy vs Slopes, honestly](https://rohan3008.github.io/alpine-support/compare)
- [Resort data, 51 verified resorts](https://rohan3008.github.io/alpine-support/resorts/)
- [Privacy policy](https://rohan3008.github.io/alpine-support/privacy)
